Name: Eruri - Erwin Smith  and Levi Ackerman move into the valley
Author: Erevendi229
Description:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/F1EZ2ZjWIAAoBNc.png[/img]



Includes: 
- Custom character sprites and portraits for Erwin and Levi 
- NPC cat Hange
- Full schedule and dialogue for all 3
- Working shop they run 
- Appear at all the festivals 
- 5 heart evens per character
- Personalized gift tastes 
- Custom maps for their garden en home 
- More than 20 quests
- 2 special portrait sets (freckled Erwin and veteran Levi, which you can swap out for the regular portraits!)

[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/5/57/Junimo.gif[/img] Version 2.0 [img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/5/57/Junimo.gif[/img]

The mod is optimized with SVE and this mod and it's dependencies are needed for it to work. It has been crosstested with other mods like Ridgeside, although not thoroughly so there may be problems 
If you run into any bugs or problems, please hit me up on twitter @Erevendi229, discorrd Erevendi or through a comment here and I will fix it as soon as possible! 
My apologies it took a full 2 years for the mod to be updated. I updated it now with a lot of content and I am planning on adding more soon (not another 2 years)

New in Version 2.0
- Their shop is added with working shopfront 
- NPC cat Hange with dialogue, schedule etc. 
- 15 new quests
- A new heart event at the end of 2 special quests late winter year 1 - go to the beach late in summer when you finish them ;)
- 2 heart events for Hange
- Year 2 content and dialogue 
- Made a clear path to their house 

Disclaimer: I'm only a novice and making this alone and with a lot of care, but there may be bugs. Please report them to me so I can fix them. 



[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/3/32/Pink_Cake.png[/img] Known possible issues in 2.0: [img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/3/32/Pink_Cake.png[/img]
- Hange is not visible in the NPC map mod since their sprite is too small 
- weeds may appear on the path to their house. I added tiledata but blocked their path so I deleted it. Will fix in the future
- One of Levi's quests is a mix bag if it works or not.
